content: The DISTINCT keyword ensures that you get unique values in your result set.
So if I want all unique job titles from 'employees', how would that look?

Like this:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT job_title FROM employees;
```
And what if I want the count of unique job titles?

You’d wrap DISTINCT in COUNT:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT job_title) FROM employees;
```
Can I also see how many employees have each job title?

Sure, use GROUP BY:
```sql
SELECT job_title, COUNT(*)
FROM employees
GROUP BY job_title;
```
